_comment: What each benchmark arm is allowed to call. run_bench.py stages one MCP config per arm and passes it
with --strict-mcp-config, so an arm gets exactly the servers listed here and nothing from your own
~/.claude.json. Without that, the baseline arm inherits every server you have registered - including
the language server this benchmark is supposed to be measuring the absence of.
The baseline arm is an agent with nothing we built, so it has no MCP servers. See
bench/BASELINE-ARM-SPEC.md before adding one: whatever you add stops being part of the difference.
allowed_mcp_tools: claude -p is non-interactive, so an MCP tool that is not listed here is refused on
every call, silently. Read-only tools only; the mutating ones are removed in run_bench.py regardless.
serena_gate: run_bench.py will not start the layers arm until Serena answers a scoped lookup AND
clangd's index resolves a known symbol. Without the second check, find_symbol_indexed answers [] in
0.1s straight after a restart, and every question is scored on 'no such symbol'. The defaults point
at the seed project in this repository; point them at a class in your own tree.
